calibrationNotes: Several low-age titles need prose warnings even when scored flags remain low.
CSM's visible label can conflict with detail text, especially for kisses or isolated insults.
The merged Violence & Scariness flag is carrying both physical peril and spooky imagery as intended.
handoffSummary.nextClaudeAction: Review the label-to-level edge cases before importing: especially 'none' labels with detail text and older 'mild' labels.
